title: Righteous Fire Chieftain
overview:
Start with a physical attack, then sustain Righteous Fire with regeneration and fire resistance. Fire Trap helps with single targets.

Build reference by Pohx. Original guide: https://pohx.net/
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/cYgy70giDjbo

Campaign items illustrate equipment progression. Use linked campaign drops you can equip. Some utility groups in campaign sets become available in later acts. Check gem requirements and combat assumptions before purchasing gear. Set the character level when you switch loadouts.

stages.title: Campaign · Physical attacks
stages.goal: Use Ground Slam early, then Sunder.
stages.priority: Keep a good physical weapon while building fire resistance and regeneration.

stages.title: Campaign · Righteous Fire swap
stages.goal: Activate Righteous Fire when your recovery supports it.
stages.priority: Add regeneration, fire resistance and suitable links.
stages.swap: Keep the physical setup until RF can stay on between packs.

stages.title: Campaign · Add Fire Trap
stages.goal: Burn packs with RF and use Fire Trap for tougher enemies.
stages.priority: Improve auras and keep resists capped after Kitava.

stages.title: Early Atlas · RF and Fire Trap
stages.goal: Use the early mapping RF setup.
stages.priority: Upgrade the shield, life and regeneration.

stages.title: Atlas · Higher map tiers
stages.goal: Follow the mapping gear set and upgrade links.
stages.priority: Check elemental ailments and regeneration before dropping a defensive aura.

stages.title: Endgame · Block
stages.goal: Use the block and Tempest Shield setup.
stages.priority: Finish defensive requirements before investing in damage clusters.
